column1: # One record per published stage3 variant. The id is the exact suffix Gentoo
# uses in its autobuild filenames, so the whole chain composes from it:
#   ... plus .asc (detached signature of the tarball — the strong guarantee),
# The latest-*.txt file is clearsigned. Verify that signature before trusting
# the path it names, then verify the tarball's own .asc, then cross-check the
# byte count the txt announces. The keyring is app-crypt/openpgp-keys-gentoo-release
# (/usr/share/openpgp-keys/gentoo-release.asc); it ships on the Gentoo live
# media, and fetching it anywhere else is itself a trust problem worth stating
# Two axes describe almost everything: init (openrc|systemd) and flavour. The
# names compose. The one exception is splitusr, which is published for openrc
# only — the selector must know that and refuse the combination at parse time
# instead of walking into a 404 after the disks have been wiped.
# constraints is a comma-separated set drawn from:
#   openrc-only         no systemd counterpart is published
#   no-multilib         no 32-bit ABI, so no wine, no steam, no 32-bit binaries
#   hardened-toolchain  toolchain built with the hardened profile
#   selinux             expects a SELinux policy and a labelled filesystem
#   libcxx-abi          Clang/libc++ userland, ABI-incompatible with libstdc++
#   experimental        upstream publishes it as such
